tasks.title: Refactor description expand/collapse layout and conditional visibility
tasks.description: Move the Expand/Collapse button outside the overflow-hidden description container so it is always visible and clickable. Add a ref-based DOM measurement to only render the button when rendered content exceeds ~600px. Preserve existing expand/collapse state behavior and gradient overlay in collapsed state.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand button is positioned outside the overflow-clipped container and is never obscured by the gradient overlay
Expand button only appears when scrollHeight > 600px; short descriptions show no button
Clicking Expand removes the height constraint and gradient, revealing full Markdown
Clicking Collapse restores the 600px height limit and gradient overlay
tasks.notes: Use useEffect/useLayoutEffect with a ref on the inner Markdown container to measure scrollHeight after initial render. Toggle an isOverflowing boolean to conditionally render the control.

tasks.title: Update expand/collapse interaction tests

acceptanceCriteria: Test verifies Expand button is absent for short descriptions (scrollHeight <= 600px)

Test verifies Expand/Collapse toggle still works after layout change
All existing description-related tests continue to pass
